evidence.report: Revision 001, L1 Three.js sampled-frame reconstruction. Compared all 24 baseline reconstruction frames with all 24 reference samples. This candidate corrects the suited gunman's aiming side and opening framing; moves him left in the rear rooftop composition; delays the main backbend, changes the arm sweep and later near/far arm poses, extends the braced leg stance, and adds the asymmetric final leg pose. It replaces the tent-like coat planes with two broad curved editable panels that wrap, billow, and settle; reduces oversized heads, hands, and dropped pistols; softens haze and lighting; corrects the helicopter's placement and several camera heights/distances; and adjusts the projectile passage timing. The final overhead camera and raised arm are reoriented to match the observed image directions. This is a complete replacement requested for rendering, not a submission. Exact cut boundaries, intersample movement, cloth motion, occluded contacts, and projectile timing remain inferred. The new candidate has not been executed or rendered locally. Fine appearance remains intentionally simplified for L1.
